SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Matter? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Matter.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Matter.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Matter.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Matter.

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Light? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Light.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Light.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Light.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Light.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Heat.

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
